simple_sim_test.rule: docs/MILESTONES.md, O7. From rest, at gravity 9.81, within 0.2 m of the exact 4.905 m after 1 s of simulated time. With gravity off, less than 1e-6 m.
simple_sim_test.first_failure: The first reading took z at 1.0 s on the timeline's clock, and the drop is 5.322 m, outside the tolerance. It stays here. Play runs 2 PhysX steps at clock 0, so PhysX had taken 62 steps of 1/60 s: 62 steps give exactly 5.322 m. The rule's time is read in PhysX steps from then on, and the limit did not change.
simple_sim_test.not_shown: Any scene but one cube. This Kit process has no window, and `app.is_running()` is already False at the start of the test.

what_the_mac_gpu_does_here.statement: Nothing. Isaac Sim does not use the Mac GPU. CPU PhysX, no RTX, no Metal.
evidence: The VM's processes have no AGXDeviceUserClient in ioreg
The only Vulkan device is llvmpipe, device type CPU
what_the_mac_gpu_does_here.licence: Isaac Sim is not modified, disassembled, or given replaced parts (6.3, 6.4, 6.13). Nothing here is Isaac Sim on Metal.
what_the_mac_gpu_does_here.what_does_use_it: Isaac Lab with Newton on warp-metal, validation/app-metal-o7.json, and the MLX policy over the bridge, validation/isaac-sim-o5.json. Isaac Lab's Newton viewer is the app screen that does appear on the Mac.

what_a_window_would_need: A device that Kit accepts. RTX needs a supported NVIDIA GPU, and the V100 is refused too (validation/isaac-sim.json), so neither machine here can show it. Not tried: Isaac Sim on a supported NVIDIA machine with its window streamed to the Mac.
